## Proposal: open several connection files at once (step 1 toward several connection databases)

@Kvarkas, a proposal before I build anything, so it fits your hub and plugin design (#3632).

### Goal
Work like SSMS: several connection sources open at the same time, each one a top-level node in the tree. This first step covers **connection files only**. Connection databases follow through your hub, and this step lays the groundwork for them.
